q: Which actor played Indiana Jones in the 1981 film Raiders of the Lost Ark?
note: Tom Selleck was the first choice but was tied up filming the television series Magnum, P.I.

q: Which actor played the hotshot pilot Maverick in the 1986 film Top Gun?
note: The US Navy reported a surge of interest from would-be pilots after the film opened.

q: Which bodybuilder turned actor delivered the line 'I'll be back' in the 1984 film The Terminator?
note: He was elected governor of California nearly twenty years later, in 2003.

q: Which actress starred opposite Richard Gere in the 1990 romantic comedy Pretty Woman?
note: The script began life as a far darker drama before it was rewritten as a fairy tale.

q: Which Scottish actor was the first to play James Bond on screen, in the 1962 film Dr. No?
note: Author Ian Fleming thought him wrong for the part at first and only came round after seeing the film.

q: Which silent film star created the bowler-hatted, cane-twirling character known as the Little Tramp?
note: He helped found the studio United Artists in 1919 so that he could control his own films.

q: Which actor played the rebellious patient Randle McMurphy in the 1975 film One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest?
note: It brought him the first of his three acting Oscars.

q: Which actor improvised the line 'You talkin' to me?' as Travis Bickle in the 1976 film Taxi Driver?
note: The screenplay said only that Bickle talks to himself in the mirror.

q: Which actor both directed and starred in the 1992 western Unforgiven?
note: He held on to the script for years, waiting until he was old enough to play the worn-out gunfighter.

q: Which actress played Holly Golightly in the 1961 film Breakfast at Tiffany's?
note: She sang 'Moon River' herself, perched on a windowsill with a guitar.

q: Which actress's white dress billowed up over a subway grate in the 1955 film The Seven Year Itch?
note: The dress itself later sold at auction for millions of dollars.

q: Which actress became the first Black woman to win the Academy Award for Best Actress, for the 2001 film Monster's Ball?
note: Sidney Poitier was handed an honorary Oscar at the very same ceremony.

q: Which director made the 1979 Vietnam War epic Apocalypse Now?
note: The shoot in the Philippines dragged on for more than a year and nearly bankrupted him.

q: Which South Korean filmmaker won the Best Director Oscar for the 2019 film Parasite?
note: Parasite also became the first film not in English to win Best Picture.

q: Which comic actor won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for playing a grieving therapist in the 1997 film Good Will Hunting?
note: Matt Damon and Ben Affleck won that same year's screenwriting Oscar for the film.

q: Which martial arts star died in 1973, a month before his film Enter the Dragon reached cinemas?
note: He was only 32, and the film turned him into a global icon after his death.

q: Which director slipped fleeting cameo appearances into most of his own films and never won a competitive Best Director Oscar?
note: He was nominated five times and finally given an honorary award in 1968.

q: Which actor became the first Black man to win the Best Actor Oscar, for the 1963 film Lilies of the Field?
note: He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1974.

q: Which actress won four Best Actress Oscars, the last of them for the 1981 film On Golden Pond?
note: She never once turned up at the ceremony to collect any of them.

q: Which actor starred in only three major films before dying in a 1955 car crash at the age of 24?
note: He became the first performer ever nominated for an acting Oscar after death.
